changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Keep the report query valid when Fineract wraps it for pagination.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH selected_office AS ( SELECT office.id, office.external_id, UPPER(office.name) AS office_name FROM m_office office WHERE office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' AND office.external_id IS NOT NULL ), posting_groups AS ( SELECT COALESCE('V:' || journal.voucher_id::text, 'T:' || journal.transaction_id, 'J:' || journal.id::text) AS posting_key, MIN(journal.office_id) AS report_office_id, MIN(journal.entry_date) AS report_date FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal WHERE journal.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal.type_enum IN (1, 2) AND NOT journal.reversed GROUP BY COALESCE('V:' || journal.voucher_id::text, 'T:' || journal.transaction_id, 'J:' || journal.id::text) ), account_amounts AS ( SELECT target_account.gl_code AS source_account_code, MIN(target_account.name) AS target_account_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 2 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS debit, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 1 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS credit FROM posting_groups posting JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry ON COALESCE('V:' || journal_entry.voucher_id::text, 'T:' || journal_entry.transaction_id, 'J:' || journal_entry.id::text) = posting.posting_key JOIN acc_gl_account target_account ON target_account.id = journal_entry.account_id CROSS JOIN selected_office office WHERE posting.report_date = CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AND posting.report_office_id = office.id AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND NOT journal_entry.reversed AND journal_entry.type_enum IN (1, 2) GROUP BY target_account.gl_code ), account_rows AS ( SELECT LEFT(amount.source_account_code, 3) AS group_code, COALESCE(group_account.name, LEFT(amount.source_account_code, 3)) AS group_name, amount.source_account_code AS account_code, amount.target_account_name AS account_name, amount.debit, amount.credit FROM account_amounts amount LEFT JOIN acc_gl_account group_account ON group_account.gl_code = LEFT(amount.source_account_code, 3) ), group_rows AS ( SELECT DISTINCT group_code, group_name FROM account_rows ), totals AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(debit), 2) AS debit, ROUND(SUM(credit), 2) AS credit FROM account_rows ), display_rows AS ( SELECT groups.group_code AS group_order, 1 AS row_order, ''::VARCHAR AS account_order, 'GROUP'::VARCHAR AS row_type, groups.group_code, groups.group_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_name, NULL::NUMERIC AS debit, NULL::NUMERIC AS credit FROM group_rows groups
UNION ALL
SELECT account.group_code, 2, account.account_code, 'ACCOUNT', account.group_code, account.group_name, account.account_code, account.account_name, account.debit, account.credit FROM account_rows account
UNION ALL
SELECT '~~~~', 3, '~~~~', 'TOTAL', NULL, NULL, NULL, 'TOTAL', totals.debit, totals.credit FROM totals WHERE totals.debit IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY row.group_order COLLATE "C", row.row_order, row.account_order COLLATE "C" ) AS row_sequence, row.row_type, office.id AS office_id, office.external_id AS office_code, office.office_name, CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AS report_date, row.group_code, row.group_name, row.account_code, row.account_name, row.debit, row.credit FROM display_rows row CROSS JOIN selected_office office ORDER BY row.group_order COLLATE "C", row.row_order, row.account_order COLLATE "C" $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Comprobante Contable por Sucursal';

changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Keep the report query valid when Fineract wraps it for pagination.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_scope AS ( SELECT selected_office.id AS selected_office_id, selected_office.name AS selected_office_name, CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) AS report_date, DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE))::DATE AS month_start, MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE))::INTEGER, 1, 1) AS year_start FROM m_office selected_office WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND selected_office.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM selected_scope scope JOIN m_office selected_office ON selected_office.id = scope.selected_office_id JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), selected_accounts AS ( SELECT account.id AS report_account_id, account.gl_code AS source_gl_code, account.name AS source_name, CASE account.classification_enum WHEN 5 THEN '004' ELSE '005' END AS classifier_code, CASE WHEN account.classification_enum = 5 THEN 'D' ELSE 'A' END AS balance_nature, account.gl_code::BIGINT AS account_order, parent.gl_code AS group_code, parent.name AS group_name FROM acc_gl_account account JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = account.parent_id WHERE account.acc_level = 4 AND account.classification_enum IN (4, 5) ), report_tree AS ( SELECT selected.report_account_id, selected.source_gl_code, selected.source_name, selected.classifier_code, selected.balance_nature, selected.account_order, selected.group_code, selected.group_name, selected.report_account_id AS descendant_account_id, ARRAY[selected.report_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM selected_accounts selected
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.balance_nature, tree.account_order, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM report_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.descendant_account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), account_balances AS ( SELECT tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.account_order, tree.group_code, tree.group_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN journal_entry.entry_date BETWEEN scope.month_start AND scope.report_date THEN CASE WHEN tree.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 2 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 1 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END END ELSE 0.00 END ), 0.00), 2) AS monthly_amount, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN journal_entry.entry_date BETWEEN scope.year_start AND scope.report_date THEN CASE WHEN tree.balance_nature = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 2 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END ELSE CASE WHEN journal_entry.type_enum = 1 THEN journal_entry.amount ELSE -journal_entry.amount END END ELSE 0.00 END ), 0.00), 2) AS accumulated_amount FROM report_tree tree CROSS JOIN selected_scope scope LEFT JOIN acc_gl_journal_entry journal_entry ON journal_entry.account_id = tree.descendant_account_id AND journal_entry.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND journal_entry.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal_entry.entry_date BETWEEN scope.year_start AND scope.report_date AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM credesal_gl_voucher opening_voucher WHERE opening_voucher.id = journal_entry.voucher_id AND opening_voucher.posting_category = 'OPENING' ) GROUP BY tree.report_account_id, tree.source_gl_code, tree.source_name, tree.classifier_code, tree.account_order, tree.group_code, tree.group_name ), visible_accounts AS ( SELECT * FROM account_balances WHERE monthly_amount <> 0.00 OR accumulated_amount <> 0.00 ), group_totals AS ( SELECT classifier_code, group_code, MIN(group_name) AS group_name, MIN(account_order) AS account_order, ROUND(SUM(monthly_amount), 2) AS monthly_amount, ROUND(SUM(accumulated_amount), 2) AS accumulated_amount FROM visible_accounts GROUP BY classifier_code, group_code ), section_totals AS ( SELECT classifier_code, ROUND(SUM(monthly_amount), 2) AS monthly_amount, ROUND(SUM(accumulated_amount), 2) AS accumulated_amount FROM account_balances GROUP BY classifier_code ), net_result AS ( SELECT ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(monthly_amount) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code = '005'), 0.00) - COALESCE(SUM(monthly_amount) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code = '004'), 0.00), 2 ) AS monthly_amount, ROUND( COALESCE(SUM(accumulated_amount) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code = '005'), 0.00) - COALESCE(SUM(accumulated_amount) FILTER (WHERE classifier_code = '004'), 0.00), 2 ) AS accumulated_amount FROM section_totals ), display_rows AS ( SELECT CASE section.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS section_order, 1 AS row_order, ''::VARCHAR AS group_order, ''::VARCHAR AS account_order, 'SECTION'::VARCHAR AS row_type, CASE section.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 'INGRESOS' ELSE 'GASTOS' END::VARCHAR AS section_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS group_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS group_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_name, section.monthly_amount, section.accumulated_amount FROM section_totals section
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE report_group.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, 2, report_group.group_code, '', 'GROUP', CASE report_group.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 'INGRESOS' ELSE 'GASTOS' END, report_group.group_code, report_group.group_name, NULL, NULL, report_group.monthly_amount, report_group.accumulated_amount FROM group_totals report_group
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE account.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, 3, account.group_code, LPAD(COALESCE(account.account_order, 9223372036854775807)::TEXT, 19, '0'), 'ACCOUNT', CASE account.classifier_code WHEN '005' THEN 'INGRESOS' ELSE 'GASTOS' END, account.group_code, account.group_name, account.source_gl_code, account.source_name, account.monthly_amount, account.accumulated_amount FROM visible_accounts account
UNION ALL
SELECT 3, 4, '', '', 'RESULT', 'RESULTADO', NULL, NULL, NULL, CASE WHEN result.accumulated_amount < 0 THEN 'DÉFICIT' ELSE 'EXCEDENTE' END, result.monthly_amount, result.accumulated_amount FROM net_result result ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY row.section_order, row.group_order COLLATE "C", row.row_order, row.account_order COLLATE "C" ) AS row_sequence, row.row_type, scope.selected_office_id AS office_id, scope.selected_office_name AS office_name, scope.month_start, scope.year_start, scope.report_date, row.section_name, row.group_code, row.group_name, row.account_code, row.account_name, row.monthly_amount, row.accumulated_amount FROM display_rows row CROSS JOIN selected_scope scope ORDER BY row.section_order, row.group_order COLLATE "C", row.row_order, row.account_order COLLATE "C" $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Estado de Resultados Consolidado';

changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Keep the canonical cash-flow statement aligned with the installed office-scope helper.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE credesal_report_office_is_root(selected_office.id, '${officeId}', '${currentUserHierarchy}') AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), cash_account_tree AS ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id AS root_account_id, configured.gl_account_id AS account_id, ARRAY[configured.gl_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account configured WHERE configured.active
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.root_account_id, child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM cash_account_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), cash_accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_account_tree ), account_ancestry AS ( SELECT account.id AS descendant_account_id, account.id AS ancestor_account_id, 0 AS distance, ARRAY[account.id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM acc_gl_account account
UNION ALL
SELECT ancestry.descendant_account_id, parent.id, ancestry.distance + 1, ancestry.account_path || parent.id FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestry.account_path) ), scoped_journal AS ( SELECT journal.id, journal.transaction_id, journal.ref_num, journal.entry_date, journal.office_id, journal.account_id, journal.type_enum, journal.amount, journal.description FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal WHERE journal.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND journal.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), cash_balances AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date < CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS opening_cash, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS period_cash_change, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END), 0.00) AS closing_cash FROM scoped_journal journal WHERE journal.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) ), period_journal AS ( SELECT * FROM scoped_journal WHERE entry_date BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), cash_transactions AS ( SELECT journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date, MIN(journal.ref_num) AS ref_num, SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) AS net_cash_change FROM period_journal journal WHERE journal.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) GROUP BY journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) <> 0.00 ), counterpart_candidates AS ( SELECT cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change, journal.id AS journal_entry_id, journal.account_id AS counterpart_account_id, journal.amount AS counterpart_amount, journal.description FROM cash_transactions cash JOIN period_journal journal ON journal.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND journal.office_id = cash.office_id AND journal.entry_date = cash.entry_date WHERE journal.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) AND ((cash.net_cash_change > 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 1) OR (cash.net_cash_change < 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 2)) ), candidate_totals AS ( SELECT cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change, COALESCE(SUM(candidate.counterpart_amount), 0.00) AS candidate_total FROM cash_transactions cash LEFT JOIN counterpart_candidates candidate ON candidate.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND candidate.office_id = cash.office_id AND candidate.entry_date = cash.entry_date GROUP BY cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change ), valid_components AS ( SELECT candidate.transaction_id, candidate.office_id, candidate.entry_date, candidate.ref_num, candidate.journal_entry_id, candidate.counterpart_account_id, account.gl_code AS counterpart_gl_code, account.name AS counterpart_name, CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS cash_direction, CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN candidate.counterpart_amount ELSE -candidate.counterpart_amount END AS net_amount, mapping.section_code, mapping.line_code, mapping.line_label, mapping.line_order, CASE WHEN mapping.gl_account_id IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS classification_status FROM counterpart_candidates candidate JOIN candidate_totals totals ON totals.transaction_id = candidate.transaction_id AND totals.office_id = candidate.office_id AND totals.entry_date = candidate.entry_date AND totals.candidate_total = ABS(totals.net_cash_change) JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = candidate.counterpart_account_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id, configured.section_code, configured.line_code, configured.line_label, configured.line_order FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN credesal_cash_flow_mapping configured ON configured.gl_account_id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id WHERE ancestry.descendant_account_id = candidate.counterpart_account_id AND configured.cash_direction = CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AND configured.active ORDER BY ancestry.distance, configured.gl_account_id LIMIT 1 ) mapping ON TRUE ), ambiguous_components AS ( SELECT totals.transaction_id, totals.office_id, totals.entry_date, totals.ref_num, NULL::BIGINT AS journal_entry_id, NULL::BIGINT AS counterpart_account_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS counterpart_gl_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS counterpart_name, CASE WHEN totals.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS cash_direction, totals.net_cash_change AS net_amount, NULL::VARCHAR AS section_code, 'AMBIGUOUS'::VARCHAR AS line_code, 'Movimientos ambiguos pendientes de clasificación'::VARCHAR AS line_label, 9999 AS line_order, 'AMBIGUOUS'::VARCHAR AS classification_status FROM candidate_totals totals WHERE totals.candidate_total <> ABS(totals.net_cash_change) ), flow_components AS ( SELECT * FROM valid_components UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ambiguous_components ), report_lines AS ( SELECT COALESCE(component.section_code, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS section_code, COALESCE(component.line_code, 'UNMAPPED') AS line_code, COALESCE(component.line_label, 'Movimientos sin mapeo contable') AS line_label, COALESCE(component.line_order, 9999) AS line_order, COUNT(DISTINCT (component.transaction_id, component.office_id, component.entry_date)) AS movement_count, SUM(CASE WHEN component.net_amount > 0.00 THEN component.net_amount ELSE 0.00 END) AS inflows, SUM(CASE WHEN component.net_amount < 0.00 THEN -component.net_amount ELSE 0.00 END) AS outflows, SUM(component.net_amount) AS net_amount, CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(component.classification_status = 'MAPPED') THEN 'CLASIFICADO' ELSE 'REQUIERE CLASIFICACION' END AS status FROM flow_components component GROUP BY COALESCE(component.section_code, 'UNCLASSIFIED'), COALESCE(component.line_code, 'UNMAPPED'), COALESCE(component.line_label, 'Movimientos sin mapeo contable'), COALESCE(component.line_order, 9999) ), sections(section_code, section_label, section_order) AS ( VALUES ('OPERATING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE OPERACIÓN', 100), ('INVESTING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE INVERSIÓN', 200), ('FINANCING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE FINANCIAMIENTO', 300) ), section_totals AS ( SELECT section.section_code, section.section_label, section.section_order, COALESCE(SUM(line.movement_count), 0) AS movement_count, COALESCE(SUM(line.inflows), 0.00) AS inflows, COALESCE(SUM(line.outflows), 0.00) AS outflows, COALESCE(SUM(line.net_amount), 0.00) AS net_amount FROM sections section LEFT JOIN report_lines line ON line.section_code = section.section_code GROUP BY section.section_code, section.section_label, section.section_order ), statement_change AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0.00) AS amount FROM flow_components ), classification_control AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_status = 'UNMAPPED') AS unmapped_components, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_status = 'AMBIGUOUS') AS ambiguous_transactions FROM flow_components ), output_rows AS ( SELECT 10 AS row_order, 'CONTROL'::TEXT AS row_type, 'EFECTIVO'::TEXT AS section_label, 'OPENING_CASH'::TEXT AS line_code, 'Efectivo y equivalentes al inicio del período'::TEXT AS concept, 0::BIGINT AS movement_count, NULL::NUMERIC AS inflows, NULL::NUMERIC AS outflows, balances.opening_cash AS net_amount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURADO' ELSE 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' END AS status FROM cash_balances balances
UNION ALL
SELECT section.section_order + line.line_order, 'DETALLE', section.section_label, line.line_code, line.line_label, line.movement_count, line.inflows, line.outflows, line.net_amount, line.status FROM sections section JOIN report_lines line ON line.section_code = section.section_code
UNION ALL
SELECT section.section_order + 99, 'SUBTOTAL', section.section_label, 'SUBTOTAL_' || section.section_code, 'Flujo neto de ' || lower(section.section_label), section.movement_count, section.inflows, section.outflows, section.net_amount, 'CALCULADO' FROM section_totals section
UNION ALL
SELECT 400 + line.line_order, 'DETALLE', 'SIN CLASIFICAR', line.line_code, line.line_label, line.movement_count, line.inflows, line.outflows, line.net_amount, line.status FROM report_lines line WHERE line.section_code = 'UNCLASSIFIED'
UNION ALL
SELECT 900, 'CONTROL', 'EFECTIVO', 'NET_CHANGE', 'Aumento (disminución) neto de efectivo', 0, NULL, NULL, change.amount, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' WHEN control.unmapped_components = 0 AND control.ambiguous_transactions = 0 THEN 'CLASIFICACION COMPLETA' ELSE 'REQUIERE CLASIFICACION' END FROM statement_change change CROSS JOIN classification_control control
UNION ALL
SELECT 910, 'CONTROL', 'EFECTIVO', 'CLOSING_CASH', 'Efectivo y equivalentes al final del período', 0, NULL, NULL, balances.closing_cash, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CALCULADO' ELSE 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' END FROM cash_balances balances
UNION ALL
SELECT 920, 'CONTROL', 'CONCILIACIÓN', 'RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE', 'Diferencia de conciliación', 0, NULL, NULL, balances.closing_cash - balances.opening_cash - change.amount, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' WHEN balances.closing_cash - balances.opening_cash - change.amount = 0.00 THEN 'CONCILIADO' ELSE 'ERROR DE CONCILIACION' END FROM cash_balances balances CROSS JOIN statement_change change ) SELECT row_type AS "Tipo", section_label AS "Sección", line_code AS "Código", concept AS "Concepto", movement_count AS "Movimientos", ROUND(inflows, 2) AS "Entradas", ROUND(outflows, 2) AS "Salidas", ROUND(net_amount, 2) AS "Flujo Neto", status AS "Estado" FROM output_rows ORDER BY row_order, line_code $report$ WHERE report_name = 'Estado de Flujo de Efectivo';
